proposedTopic.en: Organizing Game Design Ideas with Hierarchical Outlines

viewerQuestion: 늘어난 게임 기획 아이디어를 상위 목표·기능·세부 규칙으로 묶고 접고 옮겨 빠진 항목을 찾는 방법은?

sourceConcept.title: Staying Organized with Hierarchical Outlines [Planning & Game Design]
claims: Text can be managed in parent/child levels.
Branches can be expanded or folded to switch between overview and detail.
Entries can be reordered or their level changed.
Private idea organization still needs context and a clear final document for other readers.
sourceConcept.captionCaution: Japanese automatic captions contain homophone errors such as 改装/階層 and 聖書/清書. Intended meaning was checked against visible burned English captions and the actual hierarchy/reordering images. Use concept research only, not copied/translated narration or replicated source video.

relatedFullScriptComparisons.viewerQuestion: How can observed play be broken down, tested one condition at a time and recombined into a design decision?
relatedFullScriptComparisons.difference: Its look/choice/action/outcome records and test loop teach analysis of behavior. They do not teach parent/child outline levels, folding branches, or moving a heading with its children to organize a design document.

relatedFullScriptComparisons.viewerQuestion: How does a programmer start implementing from a blank project, break down a coding problem and build independent recall and verification?
relatedFullScriptComparisons.difference: Its 49 current scenes cover coding recall/recognition, implementation and review of real code. Problem decomposition overlaps only as a general skill; its concrete lesson is not hierarchical organization of a proposal/specification.

relatedFullScriptComparisons.viewerQuestion: How does a game scenario encode conditions, state, knowledge, possession and the order of player actions?
relatedFullScriptComparisons.difference: Its 16 chapters/80 paragraphs structure story logic and information access. Narrative state/branch dependencies are different from text-heading hierarchy, folding for overview and reorganizing document sections.

relatedFullScriptComparisons.viewerQuestion: What do different game-development roles do and how do they collaborate?
relatedFullScriptComparisons.difference: Documents appear as a tool for team alignment, but the full nine chapters do not explain an outline editor or a hierarchy/fold/reorder workflow. The viewer question is role selection and collaboration.

actualAdditionalMatches.title: 인디게임 데브캠프 지원사업 논란 | 왜 기획서 평가가 문제가 됐을까?
actualAdditionalMatches.comparison: Discusses grant eligibility, project stages and evaluation/transparency. Its mention of polished proposals around4:40 is not a lesson on parent/child outline levels, branch folding or document reordering. Historical allegations are not source claims for the new video.

actualAdditionalMatches.title: 게임회사 취업 준비 | 학력·자기소개서·포트폴리오 기술문서 비교
actualAdditionalMatches.comparison: The full video covers application evidence and interviews;19:02–24:14 discusses concise Markdown/video/code links and explaining one’s own contribution. This is portfolio proof, not arranging game-design ideas through a hierarchical outline editor. Historical employment advice is not reused as current advice.
Previously reviewed full play-first/tutorial content; beginning gameplay, onboarding order and teaching controls are distinct from organizing a specification.

studio.limitation: These are actual current Studio searches, not a claim that the platform searches every spoken sentence. Zero results alone did not determine the verdict; full related bilingual local scripts and the two additional channel matches were also compared.

rationale: The concrete workflow of grouping written game-design ideas into heading levels, inspecting a folded overview and reorganizing branches is absent from the reviewed current scripts/channel matches. Adjacent problem decomposition, story branching, team documents and portfolio documents answer different viewer questions and teach different operations.

productionGate.next: Before any script/TTS/scene, rerun current preflight --check and review fresh existing-game candidates, actual source actions/in-outs and usage conditions. An agent-built game/demo cannot fill the60% gameplay portion.
